requirements.general_text: Any one of these: Pass in Matriculation or Foundation studies with minimum CGPA of 2.0 and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent Pass in STPM or its equivalent with a minimum Grade C (CGPA 2.0) in any 2 subjects and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent Diploma in Computer Science OR Software Engineering OR Information Technology OR Information Systems or equivalent with a minimum CGPA of 2.5 and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent Any other Diploma in Science and technology or business studies with a minimum CGPA of 2.5 may be admitted, subject to a rigorous internal assessment process and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level or its equivalent Pass in A-Level in 2 subjects and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level Pass in New South Wales Higher Certificate with Grade C in 2 subjects, one in Mathematics South Australian Certificate of Education (SACE) 2 passes with Grade C in Mathematics Pass in 2 subjects in Canadian Pre-U (CPU) / Ontario Secondary School Diploma (OSSD) including Mathematics Pass in International Baccalaureate, with at least score of 24 Pass in Diploma in Information Technology OR Diploma in Computer Studies from any Higher Institutions Provider recognised by Malaysia Government Pass in Diploma in related field by Higher Institutions Provider recognised by Malaysia Government Other equivalent qualification recognised by the Malaysia Government English Proficiency Requirements (International students): IELTS with minimum of score 5.0 or equivalent.
